summary: One master toggle in Settings, and turning it off can free up several gigabytes of on-device model storage. Individual pieces (notification summaries, writing tools, image generation) can also be killed separately.

steps.path: Settings → Apple Intelligence & Siri → toggle Apple Intelligence off
Notification summaries only: Settings → Notifications → Prioritize Notifications → off, then Summarize Notifications → off
Writing tools & image generation only: Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions → on → Intelligence & Siri → turn off Image Creation and Writing Tools

collateral: notification summaries, writing tools, Genmoji and Siri's LLM answers all go
duplicate/overlapping Intelligence settings exist in several places — the master toggle is the one that matters
regionNotes: Availability depends on region and OS/Siri language; in some regions the feature is not offered at all.
whyTheyDidIt: Apple ties Intelligence to hardware upgrades, so it ships enabled on every capable device.

sources.label: Consumer Reports — how to turn off Apple Intelligence
Kaspersky — Apple Intelligence is refreshingly straightforward to disable
